prompt:
Subject: Polyethylene packaging material.

Composition: Show a worker pulling a thin translucent polyethylene sleeve around a plain box, with a roll of the same flexible film beside it. A small attached material card displays only the repeating unit [–CH₂–CH₂–]ₙ, linking the usable packaging to its polymer structure without branding.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. Allow only [–CH₂–CH₂–]ₙ on the material card as essential polymer notation. No other text, captions, speech balloons, labels, logos or watermark.
